verdict.reason: The source says the frequency adjustment factor (SubFAF) is calculated per Equation 4 for each of the 187 tidal gauges, and sub-type proportion is the share of EAL. Equation 5 is HM = SubHazardFAF × SubHazardProportion. The text says Minor, Moderate and Major are the sub-types, but the equations as given show no summation over only those three, and the claim misdescribes how the equations are structured.
